data.why: The app reads precomputed PDE solution arrays bundled in the repo's presets/*.npz files; there is no upload widget, so nothing needs to be copied or synthesized.

goals: Compare PINN, FFPINN, FBPINN, and FFFBPINN solution fields against a reference PDE solution to see which architecture best captures sharp features
Inspect absolute error heatmaps across the (x,t) domain to locate where each architecture's prediction deviates most from the reference
Examine 1D solution and error cross-sections at a chosen time slice to judge accuracy at a specific instant
Compare relative L2 and L infinity error metrics across architectures and training budgets (1k/2.5k/5k/10k epochs) on a log scale
Review the comparative analytics table to quantify percent error improvement and runtime slowdown relative to a 10k-epoch PINN baseline

review.summary: The tree states the dashboard's purpose correctly (comparing precomputed PINN-family variants and training budgets against a reference, plus an accuracy-versus-runtime table) and covers its five views at about the right depth, and every screen I opened matches its node. It should be filed only after fixing the baseline-selection rule in t14/f5 and adding the caveat about the table's baseline, and after folding the UI-only sidebar and export steps into other tasks.
